title: Certify integrality cuts through floors of Real terms in qf_lira
summary: QF_LIRA proofs can now certify integrality cuts through floors of Real terms on both cores: the exporter and reconstructor accept such cuts, and the reconstructor projects each step onto its Int atoms so Lean's grind finds the integer contradiction. All 330 unsat random floor runs for seeds 1-400 verify in Lean, with no new axiom or sorry.
